properties.notes: Site of a former residential care home located within Bellingham, demolished in 2012 following closure. Available for redevelopment and offers a good opportunity to provide new housing in a rural location. A scheme for development of 8 homes on the vacant land has later been permitted (15/01516/FUL). The scheme will provide homes for affordable rent. Development of 8 dwellings completed in 2017/18.
properties.site-address: Land Of Former The Shieling, Cairns Road, Bellingham
